contract: For every standard map/method pair, earliest_access_cap is the cap at the map's first real story access. Method unlocks gate availability only and never raise encounter levels.

fishing_mons.evidence: Old Rod is obtained on Route 32 after Albert.

rock_smash_mons.evidence: Rock Smash is received after clearing Sudowoodo and requires badge 1.

water_mons.evidence: Surf is received in Ecruteak and requires Mortimer's badge.
